compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem
The S1 snapshot exists in shadow mode, but reconciler read/check paths still call `load_config()`, inspect environment/cwd, hard-code tracker layout, and build Jira backends whose properties can reload ambient settings. This can change read scope during one run or discard the supplied registry config.

## Outcome
Cut `reconcile-check` and dry-run fetch/diff/preflight paths over to focused immutable `ReconcilerSettings`, `GitRuntime`, and selected `BridgeRuntime` projections. Construct exactly one selected Jira Cloud or Jira Data Center backend from those bindings; its project/query scope, TLS, timeout/limits, tracker layout, and auth capability remain stable for the operation.

## Plan
1. Add `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/runtime.py` for the focused reconciler/Git/bridge projection and provider-specific Jira static-auth carriers, composed from the S1 snapshot seam. Static fields use non-serializable Pydantic `SecretStr`/`SecretBytes`, are excluded from repr/equality/hash/cache/fingerprint, and unwrap only in the selected Jira sending adapter.
2. Change `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/_backend_registry.py` and Jira Cloud/DC factories/settings to consume the supplied projection/binding. Do not construct the unselected backend. Preserve official Jira client/ACLI TLS, timeout, retry, error, and close behavior.
3. Thread the same backend/runtime through preflight, access check, fetch, paging, inbound/outbound diff, mapper/sanitizer/property access, tracker/binding reads, and Git ref/layout owners. Remove ambient reloads from those read/check call paths.
4. Apply approved deltas explicitly: supplied Python config remains authoritative; custom tracker directory/branch/remote reaches every read owner; empty Cloud read scope fails closed; malformed config/auth fails before provider request. No write/apply path is cut over here.

## Testing (RED -> GREEN)
- Component tests construct a backend, monkeypatch every ambient resolver to raise, then exercise project/query properties, access check, paged fetch, inbound/outbound diff, mapper, sanitizer, binding lookup, and custom tracker ref reads.
- Interface tests run Cloud and DC `reconcile-check`/dry-run through CLI, Python, MCP, and direct-module paths against verified fake transports. The oracle is provider request parameters plus provider-neutral result, not private implementation shape.
- Failure tests use missing/conflicting auth, empty project/query scope, malformed TLS/URL/config, and the unselected provider's poison constructor; assert zero Jira model request/local write and typed/redacted errors.
- Secret canaries cover carriers, backend repr, exceptions, logs, provenance, request URL/query, cache/fingerprint, and the unselected adapter.
- Existing Jira auth/TLS/retry/output fixtures and ticket-sourced regressions are a required baseline; any deliberate difference is named in the ticket comment before implementation changes it.

## Compatibility / rollback
Keep a read-only compatibility facade that can delegate the read/check call to legacy composition while S2 parity/deltas are measured. No stored format changes. Rollback selects that facade before S3 write cutover; secrets are never logged for comparison.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Cloud and DC read/check interface tests complete with all ambient resolvers poisoned after composition, proving one backend/settings authority for the operation.
- [x] Supplied config and custom tracker directory/branch/remote determine every observed read/ref/query owner; ambient root-B mutations cannot alter a root-A operation.
- [x] Backend project/query/TLS/timeout/limit properties remain unchanged after environment/file mutation and the next operation observes the new composition.
- [x] Exactly the selected Jira integration is constructed; missing/conflicting auth or decision-bearing scope fails before a Jira model request or local write with no anonymous/cross-provider/principal fallback.
- [x] Secret canaries are absent from every named carrier/backend/diagnostic/wire boundary, while the selected sending adapter can authenticate the verified fake request.
- [x] Existing read/check provider-neutral outputs stay equal except the approved explicit-input, fail-fast, and stable-property deltas; disabling the read facade restores legacy behavior.
